frequency_question: How often does the RBI implement a repo rate hike within any given 100-day window under comparable macroeconomic baseline conditions?
membership_rule: Members are all 100-day rolling windows containing an MPC meeting during periods of tightening monetary policy cycles since 2011; excluded are easing or prolonged neutral pause cycles.
provenance_note: claims 90 cases from only 18 named (5.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 18 documented tightening instances captured across historical hiking clusters out of roughly 90 total MPC review cycles.
known_gaps: Excludes minor inter-meeting unannounced liquidity adjustments, focusing strictly on official repo rate changes announced via MPC resolutions.
skeleton: Total distinct MPC meeting windows evaluated across tightening phases versus total historical bi-monthly MPC windows in the timeframe.
multiplier: 18 hike events distributed across specific active tightening windows out of approximately 90 total policy review windows over 15 years.
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions to inflation and growth shocks evolve slowly over multi-year institutional regimes.
